QuestInfo.name: I Need to Find My Daughter 1
QuestInfo.parent: I Need to Find My Daughter
QuestInfo.0: I wonder how #p206# is doing in #m10001000# these days...
QuestInfo.1: I met up with #p206# in #m10001000#, and he had great news; he finally found his daughter!! There's one problem, however... She is suffering from amnesia! Bruce gave me a toy that his daughter liked to play with growing up and asked me to deliver it to her.

0.0: Oh, it's you! I have great news! Great news, indeed... If you have any spare time, then ask me what exactly that great news is. I'm going to need your help too.

yes.0: The great news is that I have found my daughter! My assistant went to some sites around #m10004000# to pick up samples. After he finished his work, he stopped by Perion for a bit, and... Apparently, he met a lady that eerily resembled my daughter!
yes.1: So he started talking to her, and... she doesn't remember anything from her childhood. She's also not a tribesperson... That has to be my daughter. It seems like she went into shock when she was attacked by the mushroom monster.
yes.2: That's the most likely reason she doesn't remember her childhood. Here... I want you to give her this sword for me. My daughter liked to pose as a knight while growing up.
yes.3: This toy sword was something she really enjoyed playing with. It may help bring back her memories of the past. Please help me help my daughter.

no.0: It really is great news, though... and I would really appreciate it if you could help me...

1.0: Hi! What? My dad is looking for me? Is that true? But I have no idea who my dad is. I don't remember anything from my childhood.
1.1: Hey, this sword... I remember this! That's right! I was attacked by a humongous mushroom, and I just ran away as fast as I could. I guess that's how I ended up here.

yes.0: I can't believe this! I remember everything! Where's my dad now? Well, here's a letter for my dad. Please get this to him ASAP.

lost.0: Please don't lose it again. This is a very important item to me. Good thing my assistant picked it up off the ground... Again, please don't lose it.
